author: Nicole Wilson
title: Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) Holdings Reduced by LaFleur & Godfrey LLC
text:
Posted by Nicole Wilson on May 9th, 2018 // No Comments
LaFleur & Godfrey LLC decreased its position in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.0% during the 4th quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 171,641 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 3,526 shares during the period. Apple comprises 7.1% of LaFleur & Godfrey LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its biggest position. LaFleur & Godfrey LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $29,047,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
A number of other hedge funds also recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. Capital Insight Partners LLC grew its stake in shares of Apple by 4.9% in the 4th quarter. Capital Insight Partners LLC now owns 6,292 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,065,000 after purchasing an additional 293 shares during the last quarter. Corundum Group Inc. grew its stake in shares of Apple by 15.4% in the 3rd quarter. Corundum Group Inc. now owns 2,242 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $346,000 after purchasing an additional 299 shares during the last quarter. Crossvault Capital Management LLC grew its stake in shares of Apple by 0.5% in the 3rd quarter. Crossvault Capital Management LLC now owns 65,678 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $10,122,000 after purchasing an additional 300 shares during the last quarter. Welch Investments LLC grew its stake in shares of Apple by 18.7% in the 3rd quarter. Welch Investments LLC now owns 1,907 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $294,000 after purchasing an additional 300 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Nadler Financial Group Inc. grew its stake in shares of Apple by 0.5% in the 4th quarter. Nadler Financial Group Inc. now owns 57,894 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,797,000 after purchasing an additional 305 shares during the last quarter. 61.12% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. AAPL stock traded up $0.89 during trading on Tuesday, reaching $186.05. 28,051,599 shares of the stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 36,914,848. The company has a market cap of $932.76 billion, a PE ratio of 20.20, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.37 and a beta of 1.26. The company has a quick ratio of 1.37, a current ratio of 1.46 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80. Apple has a twelve month low of $142.20 and a twelve month high of $187.67.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.69 by $0.04. The firm had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $60.94 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. The company’s revenue for the quarter was up 15.6% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter last year, the company earned $2.10 earnings per share. equities research analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.43 EPS for the current year.
Apple declared that its board has authorized a stock repurchase program on Tuesday, May 1st that authorizes the company to repurchase $100.00 billion in shares. This repurchase authorization authorizes the iPhone maker to buy up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock repurchase programs are generally a sign that the company’s board of directors believes its stock is undervalued.
The company also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, May 17th. Stockholders of record on Monday, May 14th will be paid a $0.73 dividend. The ex-dividend date is Friday, May 11th. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.57%. This is a boost from Apple’s previous quarterly dividend of $0.63. Apple’s payout ratio is 27.36%.
In other news, insider Angela J. Ahrendts sold 38,228 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, May 4th. The shares were sold at an average price of $176.54, for a total value of $6,748,771.12. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now owns 90,967 shares in the company, valued at $16,059,314.18. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this hyperlink . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold 164,216 shares of company stock valued at $28,084,972 in the last quarter. 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders.
A number of equities analysts have recently weighed in on the company. Atlantic Securities reissued a “neutral” rating and issued a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, May 2nd. Sanford C. Bernstein reissued a “neutral” rating and issued a $170.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, April 26th. Morgan Stanley reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $205.00 price objective (up previously from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, January 23rd. HSBC set a $204.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Tuesday, January 30th. Finally, Vetr raised Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $184.49 price target for the company in a research report on Monday, March 5th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-three have given a buy rating and two have issued a strong buy rating to the company. The company has an average rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $204.00.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide.
